data.name: Cornucopia®
data.detailed_description:
💖 Who Will You Fall For? 34+ Romanceable Villagers


🎉 Join Our Cozy Community!


🎮 Full Controller Support & Steam Deck Verified

Play Anywhere. Relax Everywhere.

Cornucopia® is Steam Deck Verified and plays beautifully with a controller—whether you're farming in bed, commuting on the bus, or tending crops on the toilet.

We're actively refining the GUI for handheld and TV play, your feedback helps shape every update!

A Nintendo Switch version is in development! Wishlist & follow to get notified the moment it launches. 🎮💚


Roadmap

🚧 Roadmap: What’s Coming to Cornucopia®

Cornucopia® is already full of cozy content, but we’re just getting started. This live roadmap shares some of the biggest updates currently in development: more love, more farming, more customization, and more magic. All shaped by your feedback.

💡 This is a dynamic, ever-evolving list, features may release in any order, and many more are already planned beyond what’s shown here.

Localization Polish: Major upgrades to Chinese, Japanese, and German, with smoother fonts, better translations, fixed alignment issues, and missing text restored—along with improvements across other supported languages.

• Steam Deck & Controls: Better snap-to interaction, cleaner menus, improved bindings, and a more intuitive controller-friendly UI.

• Flirting & Chemistry: Begin with light flirting and unlock deeper romance routes based on chemistry and player choices.

• Love Rivals: NPCs will date and marry each other if you don’t intervene. Your actions determine who falls in love… or who gets heartbroken.

• Divorce & Forbidden Love: End your marriage, or pursue someone else’s partner. Split up Richard & Daphne or Stanley & Anastasia and rewrite their destinies.

• Seasonal Festivals: Celebrate the Cow Beauty Contest, Ramen Eating Contest, Rare Animal Auction, and a heartfelt New Year’s Celebration.

• Gameplay Polish: Sharper, more satisfying farming, cooking, fishing, combat, mining, and racing. More fun, less friction.

• Customization Boost: Add new hairstyles, outfits, decor, and outdoor customization, plus a cozy TV shopping channel.

• Family Life: You can already have magical children—soon they’ll help on the farm, join you on outings, and grow with your choices.

• Animals & Genetics: Deeper animal breeding with rare traits, improved genetics, and more animal variety.

• Pet Pig: Adopt a piglet companion that grows into a loyal farm friend with personality, affection, and surprises.

• World Upgrades: Discover gem rocks, a mystery cave, terrain improvements, better maps, smarter pathfinding, and richer pet interaction.

• Tropical Island Expansion: Explore a lush island and volcano with new enemies, a boss fight, story quests, and ghostly secrets in an abandoned tiki bar.

• New Characters: Meet Bruce, Kinoko the tanuki, Nini the cooking egg, Mako the tiki bartender, and Mana the island gardener—each with unique quests, stories, and romance.

✨ Even more updates are coming! This roadmap will keep growing and evolving with the game and community.

💛 Wishlist & Follow to help shape the future of Cornucopia® and be the first to experience every cozy new adventure!


About the Game

✨ Grow the farm. Win their hearts. Raid the depths below. ✨

A cozy 2.5D farm-life RPG with 34+ romances and 50+ characters, magical animals you can breed, living soil that rewards a green thumb, and a century-old mystery waiting right under your feet. No forced bedtime. No stress. Your dream life, your pace.

Farm, build, romance, raise magical animals, and fight through the dungeons below, all in one warm, handmade world. Every choice, from who you marry to how you mix your soil, adds up to a story that's yours.

Unearth the mystery: Thawed after a century, you wake among curious villagers. A camera-loving conspiracy theorist shadows your every step. Deep below, lost relics and gemstone fruits are waiting.

  • Romance 34+ characters: Court 34+ fully romanceable villagers, marry, and start a family of your own.

  • Living soil, mega harvests: Feed your land and grow legendary crops. Easy to plant, deep to master.

  • Raise magical animals: Hatch, breed, and collect rare traits across generations.

  • Dungeons and bosses: Farm by day, then grab a weapon and dive the caves for rare loot.

  • Build your dream farm: Customize, expand, and decorate a beautiful 2.5D world.

  • No bedtime, zero stress: Play all night, set your own speed, never pass out.

🛒 Wishlist and follow Cornucopia for updates, polls, and surprises!

Cozy Comforts, Built for Your Pace

Cornucopia is built to be comfy and low-pressure, and to let you play how you like:

  • No bedtime pressure: Stay up as long as you want. No forced sleep, no pass-outs.

  • Camera angle freedom: Adjust tilt, zoom, and FOV. Flatten it to a papery storybook look, or angle it like a classic top-down farm.

  • Overflow inventory: Extra items slip straight into storage. No more full-bag frustration.

  • Tools level by use: Your watering can and axe grow stronger just from using them.

  • Adjustable game speed: Slow it down to soak it in, or speed it up to get more done.

  • Frequent updates and polls: Join an active community and help shape where the game goes next.

Raise Adorable Animals and Breed Genetic Surprises

From tiny chicks to hardworking cows, every animal grows stronger as it levels up. Chop trees with a horse, race a wild chicken, or bond with a playful slime. Breed pets across generations for rare colors and patterns, so your farm feels magical and yours. Why settle for ordinary when you can raise a dazzling midnight-blue cow?

Customize and Expand: It's All Yours

Upgrade your house, barn, coop, and shed, expand your soil, and repair the greenhouse for powerful bonuses. Build new spots like the Hot Springs, or move into a charming home like the Beach Villa, Treehouse, or Mountain Lodge. With smart storage and customizable interiors, every space becomes your own little masterpiece.

Befriend Villagers and Visit Their Homes

Charm 50+ villagers, build bonds through gifts and chats, and even redecorate their rooms once you're close. Share gossip, go on dates, and watch friendships grow on their own. Some may blossom into something more.

Grow 74 Crops, 50 Trees and 15 Berry Bushes in Living Soil

Your soil is alive. Balance nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium with compost to lift growth, yield, and rare seasonal boosts. Chase legendary crops like wasabi and juicy greenhouse watermelon hybrids, or take it slow and let nature do its thing. Season, soil, and compost all shape your harvest. Simple to plant, deep enough to obsess over. Your farm, your strategy.

Magical Kids, Meaningful Bonds

Marry one of 34+ eligible characters, from spirited youths to wise elders, and raise a child who grows from baby to toddler to child. Your partner shapes who they become: wizard kids, kappa offspring, mysterious spirit children, goddess babies, and more. It's your own family story, part cozy love, part magic.

Fishing, Arcade Games and Mini-Game Mayhem

Hook quirky catches with a bounce-style fishing system, then hit the Arcade for 10+ mini-games, including coin-pushers, claw machines, shooters, and pet races. There's always something lighthearted to do between harvests.

Buffs, Cards and Hidden Surprises

Collect cards for powerful buffs like Double Jump, Underwater Breathing, and Auto-Revive. Finish monster quests and neighbor tasks for rewards, and dig up economic perks like Shop Discounts, Faster Refining, or More Rare Fish. New cards turn up each run, so you never quite know what's coming.

Replayable Adventures and Dynamic Discovery

  • Random NPC birthdays and gifts: Each save shuffles favorite items and celebrations.

  • Animals with personality: Pets arrive with likes, dislikes, and hidden abilities you can breed forward.

  • Unique gear bonuses: Every weapon and hat rolls its own stats, so your loadout is always personal.

  • Procedural combat zones: Dive dungeons packed with rare enemies, secret bosses, and treasure rooms.

A 2.5D World Built for Cozy Wonder

Zoom in to admire the tiny farming details, or pull back to plan your next big expansion. Mix crops, orchard trees, berry bushes, and paths into a layout that's all your own. Across multiple regions and seasonal visuals, your farm feels alive year-round.

Maps, Fast Travel and Zero Stress

Discover waypoints and zip around town in a tap. Your map shows where everyone is, so there's no guesswork. Delivering gifts or prepping for a festival, everything is just a hop away.

Combat and Boss Battles

Take on dungeons with 11+ weapon types, strategic gear, and epic bosses. Explore gently at your own pace, or push deeper for rare loot, unique rooms, and real surprises.

Whimsical Hats and Fashion Freedom

Collect 90+ hats that add stat boosts or just look fabulous. From silly to sleek, every outfit tells your story.

Celebrate All Year Long

From the Chicken Festival to the cozy mountaintop Fireworks Night, every seasonal event brings its own gameplay, music, and charm. Join contests, bond with villagers, and make heartwarming memories all year round.

Auction House and Collectible Finds

Bid for rare animals, decorations, and one-of-a-kind finds in lively auctions. Compete, win, and flex your farming prestige.

200+ Recipes, Custom Meals

Cook 200+ dishes from ingredients and monster drops. Your kitchen is a cozy space for expression and mastery. Choose cookware like a Frying Pan, Bain Marie, or Fusion Cooker, each with its own boost to dish value. Then show off at the Cooking Festival in Chef Simon's restaurant for rewards.

Achievements, Badges and No Pressure

Earn 97 achievements and 5 badges entirely at your own pace. Follow the rich story path if you want one, or just wander. Control the game speed, skip the clock stress, and play however feels good.

72 Original Tracks for Every Mood

Sink into a handcrafted soundtrack that shifts with the weather, the season, and the time of day.

Choose Your Own Path

Every choice, from your spouse to your soil mix, grows into a new life. Whether you're chasing magic, family, or a little peace in the orchard, you'll find it here.

Your cozy story begins today. Start your farm now!

📝 Loving the game?

If Cornucopia brought you a little joy, a Steam review would mean the world to me. It helps other players find the game, it steers where I take future updates, and honestly it lifts my spirits more than you'd think.

Thank you for being part of this journey.

Lots of love, David 💛

🌱 Wishlist and follow Cornucopia for cozy updates, dev polls, and sneak peeks.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI 7770, Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i7 Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX960+
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04+
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 270 / NVIDIA GTX 660 or equivalent
  • Additional Notes: Game is Steam Deck Verified; runs well on Proton 8+
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04+
  • Processor: Intel i7 Processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960+ or equivalent
  • Storage: 10 GB MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for Steam Deck and Linux-compatible controllers
